answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a bonded identity registry with aging stake: voting weight accrues only as locked collateral matures, so a swarm minted at dawn cannot sway a vote. Attestation audits slash wallets whose funding clusters with a caught fake. That turns the lagoon of cheap throwaway identities into a liability - each fake needs real capital and a long wait, and its bond is forfeited if the ring is found. Rewards per identity shrink as the swarm grows while each bond costs the same, so the crystal arithmetic makes a Sybil farm unprofitable before it sways a quorum.
